text:
eli (demand-gen): Hey team — final ops checklist for next Tue's two-track webinar 'Serving Inference at Scale'. Need confirmation on registration page, Zoom config, recording + clips, and lead routing. Can y'all sanity-check?

jonah (growth): Quick wins: make two registration fields (track A / track B) so we can route follow-ups by interest. Also add UTM param guidance in the confirmation email.

tara (ops): On Zoom: we should use a single webinar session with two sequential tracks, not two concurrent webinars. We'll schedule 9:00-11:30 (track A 9:00-10:15, break 10:15-10:30, track B 10:30-11:30). Need co-hosts for each panel + cloud recording enabled.

maria (content): Speakers confirmed: Priya, Dan, Zoe. I'll send bios + preferred clip timestamps after dress rehearsal. We should record separate panelist gallery + shared screen for slides.

eli (demand-gen): HubSpot form embed is ready: `https://redwood.hubspot.com/webinars/serving-inference` — can we add a hidden `track` field to capture selection? Example snippet: `&hsFormFields[track]=A` (we'll map to property `webinar_track`).

jonah (growth): Routing rule: when `lead.source = webinar` and `webinar_score >= 100` assign to @jonah for sales outreach; otherwise nurture flow -> content series. Also create list `webinar_2026_serving_at_scale` for all registrants.

tara (ops): Zoom settings checklist (quick):
- Host: tara (ops), Co-hosts: maria, eli
- Enable cloud recording (record active speaker + gallery + shared screen)
- Auto-record on start: ON
- Enable live transcript (save transcript)
- Panelist video layout: gallery + shared screen
- Q&A enabled, attendees muted on entry
- Co-hosts can start breakout sessions for small-group office hours after main session

eli (demand-gen): For post-event: create 3 short clips (90s product highlight, 60s benchmark stat, 30s call-to-action). Tag clips with `#webinar-2026` and speaker name. Publish long-form recording to YouTube, clip edits to LinkedIn + X.

maria (content): I'll own clip edit list. Can we get rough timecodes from the recording team within 24h? Also want transcript to auto-generate SRT for captions when we publish.

jonah (growth): pls add conversion pixels in the confirmation 'thank you' page — GA4 + Meta + LinkedIn — and set UTM fallback `utm_medium=email` if unknown.

tara (ops): Zoom-bot: please schedule the webinar and confirm cloud recording settings and co-host invites.

zoom-bot: Scheduled webinar 2026-06-02T09:00Z. Cloud recording: enabled. Co-host invites sent to tara, maria, eli. Transcript enabled. Recording link will be available ~10-15 mins after end.

eli (demand-gen): Awesome. Follow-up cadence proposal: Day 0 (thank you + replay sent to registrants), Day 2 (top clip + CTA), Day 7 (benchmark report download), Day 21 (qualified leads outreach). Jonah — ok with that SLA?

jonah (growth): Fine. Make sure lead scoring rule flags questions asked in Q&A as interest signals. Also tag people who watched >50% of recording as high-intent.

maria (content): I'll prepare post-event email templates and LinkedIn carousel copy. Will share before EOD Friday for review.

eli (demand-gen): Action items summary:
- tara: finalize Zoom schedule + ensure co-hosts (IN PROGRESS)
- zoom-bot: confirm recording + transcript (DONE)
- maria: bios + clip timecodes + email copy (ETA Fri EOD)
- jonah: confirm lead routing & scoring rules in HubSpot (ETA Mon)
- eli: embed form + UTM rules + confirmation page pixels (ETA Mon noon)

jonah (growth): One more ask: add a checkbox on registration for 'share my contact with Redwood partners' to be compliant. Keep unchecked by default.

eli (demand-gen): Good catch. Tara, can we add that to the HubSpot form and surface consent in the confirmation email?

tara (ops): Yes. Will add checkbox, map to `consent_partners`, and include copy in confirmation email.

eli (demand-gen): Great — thanks team. If nobody objects, I'll lock the registration page tonight and announce the public landing tomorrow AM. :party_parrot:
